dos.title: Visit Lake Ohrid's historic churches
dos.description: Lake Ohrid is one of Europe's oldest and deepest lakes, celebrated for having 365 historic churches—one for every day of the year.

dos.title: Carry Macedonian Denars for local bazaars
dos.description: Small cafes, green markets, and Old Bazaar craft shops in Skopje prefer cash payment in Macedonian Denar (MKD).

dos.title: Register at your accommodation
dos.description: Accommodations must register foreign guests with the local police within 24 hours of arrival; keep the confirmation paper.

donts.title: Don't debate ethnic politics or naming disputes
donts.description: Discussions surrounding national identity, symbols, or the 2018 Prespa Agreement can be emotionally charged.

donts.title: Don't take unmarked pirate taxis from Skopje Airport
donts.description: Always use the official airport taxi concession desk (flat airport rate) or pre-booked transfers.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping around 10% is customary in sit-down restaurants in Skopje and Ohrid for good service.
